prompts.title: Handsome Man Relaxing at Mountain Resort
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic lifestyle portrait of a handsome man. Use the uploaded reference image strictly for accurate face and identity matching. He standing beside a rustic wooden fence overlooking a breathtaking mountain lake at sunset.
Subject:
A handsome man with neatly groomed look, wearing a relaxed dark-brown long-sleeve button-up shirt with the sleeves casually rolled to the forearms, loose cream/off-white straight-fit trousers, and clean white sneakers. He stands casually with both hands in his trouser pockets, one leg crossed naturally in front of the other, leaning slightly against the wooden fence. His body is slightly angled as he looks peacefully off-camera, with a calm, thoughtful, and slightly happy expression.
Environment & Composition:
A rustic countryside wooden cabin sits on the left side of the frame, surrounded by lush greenery, potted plants, and a large mature tree extending overhead. A friendly Golden Retriever with its mouth slightly open sits naturally on the grass to the man’s left. The subject stands centered, with a rustic wooden rail fence running horizontally through the scene. Beyond the fence is a spectacular mountain valley and a serene lake reflecting the warm sunset. Layered mountains fade softly into atmospheric haze in the distance.
Lighting:
Warm golden-hour sunset lighting, with the low sun visible near the horizon on the right side of the frame. Soft golden rim light illuminates the man’s hair, shoulders, clothing, and surrounding foliage, creating natural warm highlights, gentle shadows, and a beautiful sun flare. A soft fill light keeps his face naturally visible and properly exposed, with no underexposure.
Camera & Style:
Vertical 4:5 composition, full-body framing, eye-level camera, realistic human proportions, cinematic depth of field, natural environmental perspective, soft background separation, detailed textures, realistic skin and hair, cinematic color grading, premium travel-editorial photography, highly photorealistic, atmospheric and emotionally serene, 8K ultra-detailed quality.
Negative Prompt:
distorted face, identity change, distorted body, bad anatomy, duplicate dog, unnatural pose, blurry subject, low resolution, underexposed face, artificial skin, plastic skin, text, logo, watermark.

prompts.title: The Power Walk
prompts.prompt:
Reference & Identity
Use the uploaded image as a strict facial and body identity reference.
The subject’s face shape, jawline, nose, eye placement, beard density, skin tone, hairstyle, hairline, and overall proportions must remain extremely close to the reference.
No beautification, no face reshaping, no stylization, no identity drift.
Preserve natural skin texture, pores, beard hair detail, and realistic lighting response.
MAIN CONCEPT
Create a stylized, high-quality cinematic digital render of a young man walking his powerful dog through a wet city street at night.
The scene should feel premium, dramatic, modern, and film-like, with a confident urban mood and subtle tension.
SUBJECTS
The Man
A young man of South Asian / Middle Eastern appearance with:
Important constraint: If the reference image shows no beard or stubble, the subject must be completely clean-shaven. Do not add, enhance, suggest, or stylize any facial hair.
Clean natural hairstyle with faded sides

Athletic, muscular build
Expression & Pose

Neutral, confident, calm

Walking directly toward the camera

Relaxed but powerful posture

Eyes looking forward, slightly intense
The Dog
A large, muscular American Bully / Bulldog mix with:
Piebald coat: mostly white

Large brown/tan patch over the left eye

Brown patches across the back
Behavior & Mood

Walking beside the man on a thin leash

Slightly more aggressive/guard-like presence

Alert posture, strong chest, focused eyes

Tight jaw, subtle tension in stance (not violent, just powerful)
WARDROBE & ACCESSORIES
Clothing

Fitted olive green crew-neck t-shirt (fabric texture visible)

Grey cargo pants with large side pockets

Clean white low-top sneakers
Accessories

Thin silver chain with small circular pendant

Thin silver bracelet on right wrist

Black rugged smartwatch on left wrist
ENVIRONMENT & COMPOSITION
Setting

Modern city sidewalk at night

Wet, reflective asphalt (recent rain)

Street glowing with reflections
Background

Deep city street fading into the distance

Soft bokeh lights in white, gold, teal

Suggest traffic, neon, and tall buildings
Framing

Full-body vertical composition

Subject centered

Classic black ornamental street lamp on the right foreground as a framing element

Strong sense of depth and perspective
LIGHTING & COLOR
Lighting

Cinematic three-point lighting

Streetlight key from above & side
Soft frontal fill light subtly illuminating the face, chest, and arms so all facial features and physique remain clearly visible without flattening shadows

Soft highlights on shoulders, arms, face, and dog’s head
Strong rim lighting outlining the man and dog, creating a glowing edge separation from the dark background
Color Grade

Teal & Orange cinematic palette

Cool blues in shadows and pavement

Warm golden skin highlights and light sources
CAMERA & OPTICS
Simulated 35mm–50mm lens

Wide aperture f/1.8 – f/2.8

Shallow depth of field

Subjects razor sharp

Background fully melted into creamy bokeh
TEXTURE & QUALITY
Ultra-high resolution

Fabric weave visible

Wet asphalt reflections crisp

Beard hair, skin pores, and shadows fully realistic

Cinematic contrast and dynamic range
OUTPUT SETTINGS
Photorealistic • Cinematic • Ultra-detailed • Shallow depth • Night mood • Urban film still • 4K–8K quality • Vertical frame • 4:5 aspect ratio
